name: pi
description: Long-lived pi coding-agent sessions from Claude Code: a sandboxed session runner, a panel, a guard on ~/.pi and a check of the key-masking setup

autoOpen.title: Open the panel when a session runs
autoOpen.description: Open the pi sessions panel when a session starts running (it docks beside the transcript on wide terminals).

caWarnDays.title: Warn before the CA expires (days)
caWarnDays.description: Warn when the sandbox CA certificate (sandbox.network.tlsTerminate) expires within this many days. 0 warns only once it has expired.

allowUnsandboxed.title: Allow pi without the sandbox (exposes your key)
allowUnsandboxed.description: Let pi-session start pi when Claude Code's Bash sandbox is off. pi then reads your real provider key, and Claude's unsandboxed commands could too. Off: pi is refused outside the sandbox. Use a separate, revocable key if you turn this on.

trustedModelHosts.title: Trusted model hosts
trustedModelHosts.description: Hosts where pi may also run models defined in ~/.pi/agent/models.json, such as your company's internal model: comma-separated, as host (default port only), host:port or host:*, with *.domain for subdomains. Every provider in models.json must then be at one of them and auth.json must hold no login. Empty: opencode-go only.
